'''Vipsanis''' was the leader of a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] believed that he was destined to become the next [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], and at one point led a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] headed by the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] ''[[Victus]]'' to invade the lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endelaan]] in order to prove to his followers that he was worthy of the title. He was driven to point that he had become blinded of the atrocities he would command his [[General/Legends|general]] [[Akero]] to commit on the planet, beginning to lead to those to doubt his leadership and state of mind.<ref name="TUR" />
